mapper.sql: id, order_type, order_id, allocation_key, rule_id, rule_key, rule_version, scenario, attribution_id, sharer_member_id, campaign_key, author_member_id, contract_ref, owner_type, owner_id, currency, paid_fen, payment_fact_hash, original_amount_fen, discount_fen, point_deduct_fen, tax_fen, payment_fee_fen, channel_commission_fen, fee_basis_ref, net_fen, referral_funding_side, status, settleable_at, reversed_fen, snapshot_hash, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into marketing_revenue_allocation (order_type, order_id, allocation_key, rule_id, rule_key, rule_version, scenario, attribution_id, sharer_member_id, campaign_key, author_member_id, contract_ref, owner_type, owner_id, currency, paid_fen, payment_fact_hash, original_amount_fen, discount_fen, point_deduct_fen, tax_fen, payment_fee_fen, channel_commission_fen, fee_basis_ref, net_fen, referral_funding_side, status, settleable_at, reversed_fen, snapshot_hash, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderType}, #{orderId}, #{allocationKey}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleKey}, #{ruleVersion}, #{scenario}, #{attributionId}, #{sharerMemberId}, #{campaignKey}, #{authorMemberId}, #{contractRef}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{currency}, #{paidFen}, #{paymentFactHash}, #{originalAmountFen}, #{discountFen}, #{pointDeductFen}, #{taxFen}, #{paymentFeeFen}, #{channelCommissionFen}, #{feeBasisRef}, #{netFen}, #{referralFundingSide}, #{status}, #{settleableAt}, #{reversedFen}, #{snapshotHash}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select from marketing_revenue_allocation where id = #{id} for update
select from marketing_revenue_allocation where order_type = #{orderType} and order_id = #{orderId} for update
select from marketing_revenue_allocation where author_member_id = #{authorMemberId} order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.update: update marketing_revenue_allocation a set a.status = 2, a.update_time = now() where a.status in (1, 4) and a.settleable_at is not null and a.settleable_at <= now() and a.reversed_fen < a.net_fen and not exists ( select 1 from refund_application r where r.source_type = 'registration' and r.source_id = a.order_id and (r.status = 0 or r.payout_status in (0, 5, 6)) )

update marketing_revenue_allocation a set a.status = 2, a.update_time = now() where a.id = #{id} and a.status in (1, 4) and a.settleable_at is not null and a.settleable_at <= now() and a.reversed_fen < a.net_fen and not exists ( select 1 from refund_application r where r.source_type = 'registration' and r.source_id = a.order_id and (r.status = 0 or r.payout_status in (0, 5, 6)) )
